issues.evidence: The aggregates with no object of focus are utterly destroyed/dismantled (rnam par 'jig pa); '放下' (let go of) loses the sense of destruction.
issues.fix: 把無法抓住的身心的組成部分徹底瓦解了

issues.span: 成為無上的國王，也就是最厲害的醫生中的王
issues.evidence: The protectors become the supreme king of physicians (one title); saying '無上的國王' first suggests a separate king, which is confusing.
issues.fix: 因此成為最厲害的、醫生中的王

issues.span: 帶著想要看看外面事物的看法
issues.evidence: The mind is driven by a wish to see/fixate on outer things (views); the phrase is awkward and hard for children.
issues.fix: 心裡想著外面的東西，抱著這樣的看法

issues.evidence: The text says simply 'this is the work of Mara'; '也' implies an additional item not stated.

issues.span: 從三個領域中解脫出來
issues.evidence: They pass beyond the three realms without remainder (ma lus pa, all of them); 'without remainder' is lost.
issues.fix: 從三個領域中完全解脫出來，一個也不剩

issues.span: 他們成為人類中最傑出的領袖
issues.evidence: The 'best of humans' is an epithet of the one who turned the jewel wheel, not something the knowers 'become'.
issues.fix: 那位人類中最傑出的領袖轉動了珍寶輪
